pirs.statement: Will JuU produce formal dissenting reservations (reservationer) on prop. 2025/26:267 child-detention provisions?
pirs.trigger: JuU committee report published with reservationer section citing HD024192 grounds

pirs.statement: Will S, MP, and V parties vote against HD01SfU37 family reunification tightening in full coalition opposition?
pirs.trigger: SfU vote record shows all three parties (S+MP+V = 107 seats) voting Nej on HD01SfU37

pirs.statement: Does Lagrådet advisory on prop. 2025/26:267 contain at least one reservation or recommendation on proportionality of child-detention provisions?
pirs.trigger: Lagrådet yttrande published at www.lagradet.se with reference to prop. 2025/26:267

pirs.statement: Will the child-detention media cycle for prop. 2025/26:267 sustain national coverage for 2–10 days?
pirs.trigger: Three or more major Swedish news outlets (DN, Aftonbladet, SVT) publish articles on child-detention provisions within 10 days of motion filing
